[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 31::Three years.
]


On a bill of exchange or promissory note payable at a fixed time after date.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the bill or note falls due.
